references.text: The tribe of Asher, to which Anna belonged, was blessed by Moses before his death, pointing to the blessing that Anna herself shares in the New Testament.
Anna, who lived as a widow for many years and served God in the temple, may remind us of the widow in Isaiah 54:4 who need not fear because God is her husband.
The story of Zechariah and Elizabeth, who were also of priestly lineage and righteous before God, reflects Anna's piety and devotion.
The similarity between Simeon's blessing in the temple and Anna's song of praise and gratitude for having seen the Messiah.
